name: RigidBody
translation: 维持刚体形状的袋鼠目标。

name: A set of points which maintain their relative positions
translation: 保持各点相对位置不变的一组点。

name: Bending and stretching resistant rod
translation: 抵抗弯曲和拉伸的杆件。

name: Smooth
translation: 平滑袋鼠网格或点位置。

name: Area minimizing triangle, for generating zero mean curvature meshes
translation: 以最小面积三角形生成零平均曲率网格。

name: For generating zero mean curvature meshes
translation: 生成零平均曲率网格。

name: Collision between a pair of rigid bodies
translation: 计算一对刚体之间的碰撞。

name: Collision between a plane and a solid
translation: 计算平面与实体之间的碰撞。

name: Keep a set of points outside or inside a given Mesh
translation: 使一组点保持在指定网格内部或外部。

name: Collisions between large numbers of equal sized spheres
translation: 计算大量等尺寸球体之间的碰撞。

name: Length(Line)
translation: 维持输入线段长度的目标。

name: Length(Pts)
translation: 维持输入点之间距离的目标。

name: Set support conditions for a beam end or rigid body
translation: 设置梁端或刚体的支承条件。

name: Keep a given transformation between 2 points
translation: 保持两点之间给定的变换关系。

name: Load
translation: 向点施加荷载。

name: Apply equal vertical loads to all vertices of a mesh
translation: 向网格所有顶点施加相等的竖向荷载。

name: Set the total volume of a mesh
translation: 设置网格的目标总体积。

name: Wind
translation: 向网格施加风力。

name: Attempt to assign a boolean to each vertex of a mesh such that no connected vertices share the same value
translation: 将网格顶点分为两组，使相连顶点不属于同一组。

name: Refine a Mesh, separating outputs by parent face
translation: 细分网格，并按原始面片对输出分组。

name: Attempt to assign a boolean to each face of a mesh such that no adjacent faces share the same value
translation: 将网格面片分为两组，使相邻面片不属于同一组。

name: Replace each edge with a new face
translation: 将每条边替换为一个新面片。

name: Show points as round dots
translation: 将点显示为圆点。

name: Removes similar lines from a list.
translation: 从列表中移除重复或相近的直线。

name: Removes similar points from a list
translation: 从列表中移除重复或相近的点。

name: Offset a conical mesh so that corresponding faces are constant distance apart
translation: 偏移锥化网格，使对应面片之间保持恒定距离。

name: Measure the current angle between two triangles about their common edge
translation: 测量两个三角面绕公共边形成的当前夹角。

name: Get the 4 points for each internal edge to use in a Hinge Force
translation: 提取各内部边对应的四个点，供铰链力使用。

name: Combine and Clean a list of meshes, removing unused and duplicate vertices
translation: 合并并清理网格列表，移除未使用和重复的顶点。

name: Extract corners sharper than some angle
translation: 提取锐度超过指定角度的角点。

name: Sort the face directions of a mesh
translation: 整理网格面片的方向。

name: Map points from one mesh to another
translation: 将点从一个网格映射到另一个网格。

name: Rotate the vertex order of each face
translation: 轮换每个网格面片的顶点顺序。

name: 3d Möbius Transformations of any geometry using 4d rotation
translation: 利用四维旋转对几何对象进行三维莫比乌斯变换。

name: Morph geometry from reference polygons to offset cells of a tri,quad or ngon mesh
translation: 将几何对象从参考多边形映射到三角形、四边形或多边形网格的偏移单元。

name: Create a branching pipe around a network of lines/curves
translation: 沿线段或曲线网络创建分支管道。

name: Sorts the vertices of a mesh into 2 lists according to whether or not they are surrounded by faces
translation: 按是否被面片环绕将网格顶点分为两组。

name: Display face planarity as a coloured mesh
translation: 用着色网格显示各面片的平面度。

name: Directional subdivision, refines quads in one direction only
translation: 单方向细分四边形面片。

name: Break a polyline into multiple parts based on angle
translation: 按转角将多段线拆为多个部分。

name: Divide a mesh into strips
translation: 将网格划分为条带。

name: Combine 2 SubD objects
translation: 融合两个细分曲面对象。

name: Generate face incircles, circle packing centred on vertices, or incircular dual
translation: 生成面片内切圆、以顶点为中心的圆形填充或内切圆对偶结构。

name: Unroll a strip of quads
translation: 展开一条四边形网格条带。

name: Returns the positions of the vertices connected the given vertex by an edge
translation: 返回与指定顶点通过边相连的其他顶点位置。

name: Separate the edges of a mesh into 2 lists according to Warp and Weft direction
translation: 按照经纬方向将网格边线分为两个列表。

name: Remeshing with edge lengths dependent on the vertex colours of the input mesh
translation: 根据输入网格的顶点颜色控制边长，重新划分网格。

name: Remeshing tool
translation: 重新划分网格的工具。

name: Isotropically remesh a Brep or Mesh
translation: 对 Brep 或网格进行各向同性重构。

name: Simple Target Length
translation: 设置简单的目标边长。

name: Convert a Brep or Mesh into a mesh of near equilateral triangles
translation: 将 Brep 或网格重构为近似等边三角形网格。

name: Align faces of a pair of rigid bodies
translation: 对齐一对刚体的面片。

name: Adjust a quad mesh to make vertices conical - so the mesh has a face-face offset (See the paper 'The focal geometry of circular and conical meshes' for details). Use together with Planarize
translation: 调整四边形网格，使顶点具有锥性并可实现面面偏移；建议与网格面平面化配合。

name: Collisions between a collection of deformable meshes
translation: 计算一组可变形网格之间的碰撞。

name: Make a quadrilateral have a circumscribed circle
translation: 使四边形具有外接圆。

name: Turn a triangular mesh into developable patches with creases. Based on the paper 'Developability of Triangle Meshes' by Stein, Grinspun & Crane
translation: 将三角网格变为带折痕的可展曲面片。

name: A load in the negative Z direction, which updates its magnitude according to the length of the line
translation: 施加沿 Z 轴负方向的荷载，其大小随线段长度变化。

name: For generating minimal and CMC (zero and constant mean curvature respectively) meshes which adapt their connectivity during relaxation to maintain triangle quality
translation: 生成最小曲面和恒定平均曲率网格；松弛时动态调整连接以维持三角面质量。

name: Like Hinge, except folding beyond the plastic/elastic threshold will alter the rest angle
translation: 类似铰链目标，但折叠超过塑性阈值后会改变静止角度。

name: This tries to preserve the length of the line elastically, until it is deformed beyond the limit, then its rest length gets changed
translation: 弹性维持线段长度；形变超过阈值后会改变静止长度。

name: Smooth a mesh only in the local tangent planes. Used in conjunction with SoapFilm
translation: 仅在局部切平面内平滑网格，常与肥皂膜目标配合。

name: Snap length to whole number multiples of a given number
translation: 将长度吸附到指定数值的整数倍。

name: To stop the sides of a hinge passing through each other
translation: 阻止铰链两侧互相穿透。

name: Circle packing with sizes from image colours
translation: 根据图像颜色控制圆尺寸进行圆形填充。

name: This lets you drag Kangaroo particles in Rhino viewports
translation: 允许在 Rhino 视口中拖动袋鼠粒子。

name: This lets you drag particles in Rhino. Hold Alt key and drag with LMB, or toggle anchors with LMB+RMB
translation: 在 Rhino 中按住 Alt 并用鼠标左键拖动粒子；左右键组合可切换锚定。

name: This lets you drag particles in Rhino. Hold Left Ctrl and drag with LMB, or toggle anchors with LMB+RMB
translation: 在 Rhino 中按住左 Ctrl 并用鼠标左键拖动粒子；左右键组合可切换锚定。

name: Divide each quad into 4 quads, and each triangle into 4 triangles
translation: 将每个四边形面细分为四个四边形面，每个三角面细分为四个三角面。

name: Draws one line between every pair of points in a list
translation: 在列表中每对点之间绘制一条连线。

name: CoCircular
translation: 使目标几何共圆。

name: CoLinear
translation: 使目标几何共线。

name: CoPlanar
translation: 使目标几何共面。

name: CoSpherical
translation: 使目标几何共球。

name: Align a line segment with a given vector, or if none supplied, the closest of the World XYZ vectors
translation: 将线段对齐到指定向量；未提供时对齐到最接近的世界坐标轴方向。

name: Make a quad mesh S-Isothermic, as described in the paper 'Quasiisothermic Mesh Layout' by Sechelmann, Rörig & Bobenko
translation: 按准等温网格布局方法，使四边形网格趋于 S-等温网格。

name: Maintain a fixed ratio between the lengths of a pair of lines
translation: 维持两条线段长度之间的固定比例。

name: TangentIncircles
translation: 使内切圆保持相切。
